title: SWF: Compressed SWF (CWS) vs uncompressed (FWS) header
description: Test that exportSWF produces either CWS (zlib compressed) or FWS (uncompressed) output. Verify: (1) bytes[0..2] is 'CWS' or 'FWS', (2) bytes[3] is SWF version 8, (3) total file size in bytes[4..7] matches actual uncompressed size, (4) if CWS: bytes 8+ are zlib-compressed data, (5) the SWF is valid regardless of compression choice. Also verify 4-byte frame size field (bytes[20..23] for uncompressed).
